cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: What is a gap-up?
cards.body: When a stock or index opens above yesterday's close. For Nifty we measure it as GIFT Nifty's morning level minus Nifty's last close.

quiz.q: Nifty closed at 25,000. GIFT Nifty shows 25,150 at 8:30 am. What is the likely gap?

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: What is a 52-week high?
cards.body: The highest price a stock reached in the last one year. A stock at a new 52-week high is trading above every price of the past year.

quiz.q: A stock's highest price this year was Rs 500. Today it closes at Rs 510. What did it make?

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: What is market cap?
cards.body: Share price times the number of shares. It is the market value of the whole company.

quiz.q: 10 crore shares at Rs 200 each. What is the market cap?

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: Large, mid and small caps
cards.body: In India, the 100 biggest companies by market cap are large caps, the next 150 are mid caps, and the rest are small caps (SEBI's rule).

quiz.q: A company ranked 180th by market cap is a ...

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: What is a circuit?
cards.body: A daily price limit set by the exchange. When a stock hits its upper or lower circuit, trading can freeze at that price for the day.

quiz.q: A stock has a 5% band and closed at Rs 100. Where is its upper circuit today?

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: FII and DII
cards.body: FIIs are foreign investors. DIIs are Indian institutions like mutual funds and insurers. Their daily net buying is published by NSE every evening.

quiz.q: Mutual funds buying Indian shares count as ...

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: What is relative strength (RS)?
cards.body: How a stock has done compared with the whole market. An RS rating of 90 means it did better than 90% of stocks.

quiz.q: A stock with an RS rating of 85 has done better than ...

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: What is market breadth?
cards.body: How many stocks rose against how many fell. An index can rise while most stocks fall if a few big names carry it.

quiz.q: Nifty is up 0.5% but 1,800 stocks fell and 700 rose. Breadth is ...

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: What is P/E?
cards.body: Price divided by yearly earnings per share. It tells you how many years of today's profit the price pays for.

quiz.q: Price Rs 300, earnings per share Rs 15. What is the P/E?

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: What is an order book?
cards.body: The total value of work a company has won but not yet delivered. Order wins are often compared with its yearly revenue.

quiz.q: Revenue is Rs 1,000 cr and a new order is Rs 300 cr. The order is ...

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: What is a promoter pledge?
cards.body: When promoters borrow money against their own shares. A high pledge can force share sales if the price falls a lot.

quiz.q: Why do people watch promoter pledges?
o: Falling prices can force share sales

cards.label: Learn in 30 seconds
cards.title: What is the 200-day average?
cards.body: The average closing price of the last 200 sessions. Many investors use it to tell a long uptrend from a downtrend.

cards.label: Story
cards.title: Tata Steel plans to buy the promoter stake in APL Apollo Tubes for Rs 15,510 crore and make an open offer for another 26 percent, a total of up to Rs 32,266 crore. At the same time, APL Apollo will buy Tata Steel's tubes and colour coated businesses for Rs 28,000 crore. SEBI chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey has said the regulator is looking at the deal, as minority shareholders' interest is very important. Proxy advisers had raised questions on valuation, financing and governance.

cards.label: Story
cards.title: The RBI has cut the daily minimum CRR that banks must keep with it to 90% from 99%, from the fortnight starting 1 Dec. The CRR itself stays at 3%. It was made stricter only on 16 Oct, when banks had extra cash, but bank cash slipped into deficit for the first time in five months after big GST payments and the RBI's dollar selling. For savers nothing changes directly, but it shows how closely the RBI watches money in the banking system.

cards.label: Story
cards.title: SEBI has cleared Svatantra Microfin, the microlender led by Ananya Birla, for a Rs 3,000 crore IPO. Half of it is fresh money for the company and half is old investors selling their shares. The lender manages Rs 21,093 crore of microfinance loans and its bad loan ratio fell to 1.19% in FY26. The price band and dates are not out yet.

cards.label: Story
cards.title: Global brokerage Nomura now expects the RBI to raise the repo rate by 50 basis points on 4 December, double its earlier call of 25 basis points. That would take the repo rate from 5.50% to 6.00%. The reason is food prices: retail inflation hit 6.1 per cent in October and Nomura sees it near 6.4 per cent in November. Most economists still expect a smaller 25 basis point hike, so 4 December is a big day for loan EMIs and deposit rates.
